hero.title:
Useful steps.
Even without service.
hero.lead: Short emergency guidance and ordinary files you can open without the internet. Reviewed November 9, 2026. Follow current local alerts and responders first.

alert.title: Immediate danger?
alert.text: In the United States, call 911 for police, fire, or ambulance emergencies. Tell the call-taker your location and what happened. Follow their instructions.

orientation.title: Get oriented in three steps
orientation.note: This offline package cannot show live alerts.

steps.title: Get to safety
steps.text: Move away from the hazard without putting yourself in danger. Follow local officials.

steps.title: Call and listen
steps.text: For an emergency, call 911. If available, check local alerts, radio, and NOAA Weather Radio.

steps.title: Open a card
steps.text: Find the situation below. Every card also has a plain text file in guides/.

personal.title: Your files
personal.media_text: Place your own files in these folders. You can always open them directly in a file manager.
personal.rebuild: Optional: run python tools/build.py to add links to this page. Python is not needed to use the folders.
personal.private_text: Set up and test an encrypted vault before adding IDs, health records, or other sensitive files. Keep the password and recovery key away from the USB drive.
personal.private_note: Digital copies do not replace original documents. Test on your own devices.
personal.empty: No personal files indexed yet. Open the folders in your file manager.

sources.title: Sources and review date
sources.description: The situation cards are original summaries based on the listed primary sources. Third-party PDFs are linked, not included.
sources.current: Alerts, health guidance, prices, and local procedures can change. Check the responsible local agency when you have service.
sources.starter: Prepare and test the USB drive
